description: This file defines a PHP class `SugarWidgetSubPanelSelectAllButton`, which extends `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton` and provides a method to generate an HTML form button labeled 'Select All' for use in a subpanel interface within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelSelectAllButton
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton, providing a UI element to select all items within a subpanel.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns HTML code for a form with a 'Select All' button to be rendered in the user interface.
